outputs.L2: The invention relates to a method comprising: supplying a frame component adapted for placement over a device wall box, the frame component having at least one frame aperture with a lip portion arranged to extend substantially into an interior area of the device wall box, the frame aperture also being arranged to generally establish a modular space; and supplying at least one modular electrical wiring device shaped to substantially fit within that modular space according to at least one of multiple modular configurations. outputs.L3:
The method provides a frame member configured to be disposed over a device wall box. The frame member is positioned so that it overlies the wall box opening and serves as an interface between the device wall box and one or more electrical wiring devices to be mounted therein.

The frame member includes at least one frame opening. The frame opening is provided with a lip member that extends inwardly into the interior region of the device wall box. This lip member may help define the boundary of the opening, provide structural support, and guide or retain a device positioned within the frame opening.

The frame opening is configured to define a modular space for receiving a modular electrical wiring device. The modular space establishes a standardized mounting region within the frame member, allowing compatible modular devices to be inserted, aligned, and supported relative to the wall box.

The modular electrical wiring device is configured to conform to the modular space according to one or more modular configurations. In this manner, different types or sizes of modular electrical wiring devices may be received within the modular space, provided that they correspond to a compatible modular configuration. The modular configuration may define the shape, size, alignment, and mounting relationship between the device and the frame member.

The modular electrical wiring device further includes attachment structures configured to mate with corresponding portions of the frame member. These attachment structures allow the modular electrical wiring device to be secured to the frame member. The attachment structures are arranged so that the modular electrical wiring device can be installed in multiple orientations relative to the frame member, including orientations that are orthogonal to one another. As a result, the same modular electrical wiring device may be selectively mounted in different rotational positions, providing flexibility in installation and compatibility with different wiring arrangements or user preferences.
outputs.L4:
A modular electrical wiring installation method provides a flexible way to install electrical wiring devices, such as switches, receptacles, controls, communication connectors, or similar components, in a wall-mounted device box. The method uses a frame member that is positioned over or adjacent to the open front of a device wall box. The frame member includes a lip or projecting portion that extends at least partially into the interior of the wall box. This lip helps define a modular receiving space within the box, allowing one or more compatible wiring devices to be installed in a controlled and repeatable manner.

The frame member serves as an interface between the wall box and the wiring device. Instead of requiring each device to be mounted directly to the wall box in a fixed orientation, the device can be secured to the frame member. The modular space created by the frame allows different types of wiring devices, adapters, or device modules to be received and supported in the same general installation opening. This makes it possible to use a common wall box and frame arrangement for multiple device configurations.

A wiring device used with the system may include mounting features that cooperate with corresponding features on the frame member. These features may allow the device to snap into place, slide into position, fasten with screws, or otherwise attach securely to the frame. Once mounted, the wiring device is held in the desired position relative to the wall box and the surrounding wall surface. A cover plate or faceplate may then be installed over the frame and device to provide a finished appearance.

The system also allows the wiring device to be mounted in more than one orientation. For example, the device may be installed in a first orientation or rotated into a second orientation that is orthogonal, or generally perpendicular, to the first. This capability permits the same device or module to be used in different installation layouts, such as vertical or horizontal arrangements, depending on the application. The ability to reposition or rotate the device can be especially useful in installations where space is limited, where wiring entry points vary, or where a particular user interface orientation is preferred.

By separating the mounting function from the wall box itself and providing a modular frame, the method increases installation flexibility. Electricians or installers can configure the same basic assembly to accommodate different wiring devices, device combinations, and mounting orientations without needing a specialized wall box for each arrangement. The result is an adaptable electrical installation system that can simplify installation, improve compatibility among components, and support future changes or upgrades to the wiring device configuration.
outputs.L5:
**The Power of “The”**

“The” is one of the smallest and most common words in the English language, yet it plays an important role in how we communicate. It helps us point to something specific, making our meaning clearer and more precise. For example, saying “a book” could mean any book, but saying “the book” tells us that we are talking about one particular book.

Although “the” may seem simple, it appears everywhere: in stories, conversations, articles, and instructions. It helps connect ideas and gives structure to sentences. Without it, English would often sound incomplete or unclear.

In many ways, “the” proves that even the smallest words can have great importance. It may not attract much attention, but it quietly supports the language we use every day.

counterfactuals.prompt: Convert this concept into US patent application language: a frame disposed over a device wall box, openings with lips extending inward, and interchangeable modular electrical devices that conform to the openings and can be installed horizontally or vertically.
counterfactuals.output:
Below is sample U.S. patent application-style language for the concept.

---

## Example Patent Application Language

### Abstract

An electrical wall box cover assembly includes a frame configured to be disposed over a device wall box. The frame defines a plurality of device-receiving openings, each opening including an inwardly extending lip. A plurality of interchangeable modular electrical devices are selectively receivable in the openings. Each modular electrical device includes a housing dimensioned to conform to one of the openings and to engage the inwardly extending lip. The modular electrical devices are configured for installation in either a horizontal orientation or a vertical orientation relative to the frame, thereby permitting reconfigurable placement of electrical devices within the frame.

---

## Detailed Description

An electrical device mounting assembly is provided for use with a device wall box, such as a single-gang, multi-gang, or other electrical wall box. The assembly includes a frame configured to be positioned over, adjacent to, or at least partially within an opening of the device wall box. The frame may be secured to the wall box, to a wall surface, or to another support structure by fasteners, clips, snap-fit features, adhesive, or any other suitable attachment structure.

The frame includes one or more openings configured to receive modular electrical devices. In certain embodiments, the frame includes a plurality of openings arranged in a row, column, grid, or other pattern. Each opening is bounded by an edge portion of the frame. At least one lip extends inwardly from the edge portion toward an interior of the opening. The lip may extend continuously around the opening or may be formed as one or more discrete lip segments. The lip may provide a support surface, retention surface, alignment surface, stop surface, or combinations thereof for a modular electrical device received in the opening.

Each modular electrical device includes a housing or body configured to be inserted into one of the openings of the frame. The housing may have an outer perimeter shape corresponding to the shape of the opening so that the modular electrical device conforms to the opening when installed. In some embodiments, the housing includes one or more engagement features configured to cooperate with the inwardly extending lip. Such engagement features may include shoulders, grooves, recesses, snap tabs, latches, resilient arms, detents, flanges, or other retaining structures. Engagement between the modular electrical device and the lip may maintain the modular electrical device in a mounted position relative to the frame.

The modular electrical devices are interchangeable with one another. For example, the modular electrical devices may include any combination of switches, dimmers, receptacles, USB charging outlets, data ports, communication connectors, sensors, indicators, blank inserts, low-voltage control modules, or other electrical or electronic devices. Any such modular electrical device may be selectively installed in any compatible opening of the frame.

The openings and the modular electrical devices may be configured such that a modular electrical device can be installed in more than one orientation. In certain embodiments, each modular electrical device can be installed in either a horizontal orientation or a vertical orientation relative to the frame. For example, an opening may have a generally square, rectangular, rounded-rectangular, or other symmetrical or orientation-compatible geometry, and the modular electrical device may have a corresponding geometry that permits installation after rotation by approximately ninety degrees. The lip and the engagement features may likewise be arranged to permit engagement in either orientation.

In use, the frame is positioned over a device wall box, and one or more modular electrical devices are selected according to a desired configuration. Each selected modular electrical device is inserted into a corresponding opening in the frame and retained by engagement with the inwardly extending lip. The modular electrical devices may be removed and replaced with other modular electrical devices, or reoriented between horizontal and vertical positions, without requiring replacement of the frame.

---

## Example Claims

### Independent Claim

1. An electrical device mounting assembly comprising:  
   
   a frame configured to be disposed over a device wall box, the frame defining at least one opening;  
   
   a lip extending inwardly from an edge of the at least one opening; and  
   
   a modular electrical device selectively receivable in the at least one opening, the modular electrical device comprising a housing having an outer perimeter configured to conform to the at least one opening,  
   
   wherein the housing is configured to engage the lip to retain the modular electrical device relative to the frame, and  
   
   wherein the modular electrical device is installable in the at least one opening in a first orientation and in a second orientation different from the first orientation.

### Dependent Claims

2. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the first orientation is a horizontal orientation and the second orientation is a vertical orientation.

3. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the second orientation is rotated approximately ninety degrees relative to the first orientation.

4. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the frame defines a plurality of openings, each opening being configured to receive one of a plurality of interchangeable modular electrical devices.

5. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 4, wherein each of the plurality of interchangeable modular electrical devices is selectively installable in any one of the plurality of openings.

6. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the lip extends continuously around the at least one opening.

7. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the lip comprises a plurality of discrete lip segments spaced around the at least one opening.

8. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the housing comprises at least one retention feature configured to engage the lip.

9. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 8, wherein the at least one retention feature comprises a groove, recess, shoulder, latch, snap tab, or resilient arm.

10. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the modular electrical device comprises a switch, receptacle, dimmer, communication connector, charging port, sensor, indicator, or blank insert.

11. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the frame is configured to be secured to the device wall box by one or more fasteners.

12. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the at least one opening has a shape that permits the modular electrical device to be received in the at least one opening after rotation of the modular electrical device relative to the frame.

13. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the lip defines a stop surface that limits insertion of the modular electrical device into the at least one opening.

14. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the modular electrical device is removable from the frame and replaceable with a different modular electrical device.

15. The electrical device mounting assembly of claim 1, wherein the frame comprises a face portion configured to overlie a wall surface surrounding the device wall box.

---

## Alternative Broader Independent Claim

1. A reconfigurable electrical device system comprising:  
   
   a frame configured for mounting relative to a wall box, the frame including a plurality of device-receiving apertures, each device-receiving aperture including an inwardly projecting retaining lip; and  
   
   a plurality of modular electrical device units, each modular electrical device unit having a body shaped to be received within any selected one of the device-receiving apertures and to cooperate with the retaining lip of the selected device-receiving aperture,  
   
   wherein the modular electrical device units are interchangeable among the plurality of device-receiving apertures, and  
   
   wherein at least one of the modular electrical device units is receivable in a selected device-receiving aperture in either a horizontal mounting orientation or a vertical mounting orientation.

---
